ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the power supply is labeled Vsource = 15 V; the upper series resistor is labeled Rseries = 500 Ω; the output node is connected to a Zener diode to ground, labeled Vz = 5.1 V; the same output node is also connected to the load resistor Rload to ground, so the Zener diode and the load are in parallel. The problem gives Rload = 680 Ω and asks for Izener. Reasoning calculation: When the Zener is regulating voltage, the output node voltage is approximately 5.1 V. The series resistor current Iseries = (15 − 5.1) / 500 = 0.0198 A = 19.8 mA. The load current Iload = 5.1 / 680 = 0.0075 A = 7.5 mA. By KCL at the output node, Izener = Iseries − Iload = 19.8 − 7.5 = 12.3 mA.
